# Pilot summary (auto-generated by code/aggregate.py)

speedup = IQ-TREE default wall / method wall (replayed rules: trace time at stop + post-search time). dlnl = lnL(method tree) - lnL(default tree), both re-evaluated in one IQ-TREE -z run (same model). W/T/L on dlnl with tie band 0.5 lnL. Wilcoxon signed-rank on dlnl. AU plausible = p-AU > 0.05 among all candidate trees of the dataset. nRF to the default tree; FN to the true tree (sim only; true branches <= 1e-5 contracted).
